entities.name: spec/rules.md
entities.description: The contract stating the rules set is capped at 2500 lines and describing how the cap is measured and enforced.

entities.name: Henri
entities.description: The person at whose ask this contract was written, who sets and moves the line caps in writing with a date, and who owns spec/author.md and the promotion pass.

entities.name: board/README.md
entities.description: One of the five rules documents; describes how a task is worked and is where 'status blocked' is real.

entities.name: manifesto.md
entities.description: One of the five rules documents; describes how an instrument fails, and states the rule that a cap not measured is a mood.

entities.name: spec/author.md
entities.description: One of the five rules documents; describes what the author spends attention on, and is the author's own document.

entities.name: doc/instruments.md
entities.description: One of the five rules documents; describes what a session already has to work with, and grew fastest in the measured window.

entities.name: vision.md
entities.description: One of the five rules documents; describes what any of it is for, and is deliberately kept short as an atrophy control.

entities.name: The 2500-line cap
entities.description: The rule that the five rules documents together may not exceed 2500 lines total, moved once from 2000 by Henri.

entities.name: tools/rulecount.py
entities.description: The script that counts the five rules files, prints the total, and the room left under the cap.

entities.name: card:working-standard.md
entities.description: The card that owns getting the rules count under the cap, and recorded the restatement-fat problem on 2026-08-18.

entities.name: card:memory-atrophy.md
entities.description: Card whose move 3 (2026-08-24) states the cap's second reason: a method recited is worth more than a longer one searched.

entities.name: tools/seedaudit.py
entities.description: Tool that names board/README.md and spec/author.md as pieces and refuses their loss.

entities.name: journal.md
entities.description: The open month plus index of session narration; has an 8,000-line budget and is moved (rotated) because it is searched, not read wholesale.

entities.name: doc/notes/
entities.description: Former source of the retired name 'the method files' for the five rules documents, carrying the same false assumption about loading.

entities.name: tools/suite.py
entities.description: Tool that puts the rules count on test/gates.md as an andon and prints it at every commit through the hook, without changing exit code; also the lamp for journal rotation.

entities.name: test/gates.md
entities.description: File where the rules-cap andon appears as a row or red section depending on room remaining.

entities.name: test/test_rules.py
entities.description: Test that refuses the loss of one of the five rules documents and tests that the lamp itself can light.

entities.name: MEMORY.md
entities.description: A private 29-line index read by every session, holding hooks for the memory corpus; rules-shaped but not counted in the 2500-line cap.

entities.name: doc/memory/
entities.description: Location where the bodies of the memory corpus now live, spec-shaped and costing nothing until opened.

entities.name: tools/journalroll.py
entities.description: The mechanism that rotates the journal, closing months and generating the index block.

entities.name: test/test_journal.py
entities.description: Test that refuses a missing or malformed journal rotation/index, the half that checks the lamp can light.

entities.name: journal/YYYY-MM.md
entities.description: A closed, append-only month of the journal, never edited again after closing.

entities.name: test/test_citations.py
entities.description: Test that searches the open journal month and the archive as one corpus so citations don't rot.

entities.name: keeper.md
entities.description: Standard work for the keeper's evening (the fire), of which journal rotation is the fifth act.

entities.name: the fire
entities.description: The keeper's evening, a standing appointment into which journal rotation was folded on 2026-08-21.

entities.name: spec/sandbox.md
entities.description: Applies the same 'a cap not measured is a mood' rule to the fence, as manifesto.md does to the rules cap.

entities.name: the three cheats
entities.description: Named ways the 2500-line cap could be met without reducing context: a sixth document, dropping dates, or pushing text into another rule.

entities.name: the atlas
entities.description: Referenced structure closed at five sheets under the same rule that a sixth caller/document is a cheat.

entities.name: status blocked
entities.description: The state that is real in board/README.md, cited as why that document can't simply be split.

entities.name: grudge class
entities.description: An entry whose facts belong in the archived record but whose heat should get no index line at rotation.

entities.name: the index
entities.description: The one-line-per-closed-month block in journal.md's head naming themes, generated by journalroll.py --index and checked by test_journal.py.

entities.name: the 2000-line cap
entities.description: The original cap set by Henri on 2026-08-20, later moved to 2500 on 2026-09-06.

entities.name: 8000-line journal budget
entities.description: Budget on the open journal.md, proposed by a session on 2026-08-21 and Henri's to move, anchored to what one person can skim in a sitting.

entities.name: the earning test
entities.description: The test for whether a sentence belongs in a rule document versus the journal: whether a stranger needs it to follow the rule, not just believe it.
